evidence: Labeled P2P and changes outbound message validation in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
rationale: Prevents memory corruption and crashes by enforcing type and payload length checks prior to transport encoding. Without this check, 'V1 aborts on a longer type, while V2 sends a truncated type with the payload intact or writes past its encoding buffer when the payload is shorter than the excess type bytes' (PR description and commit caea75f11b).
